title: Study Arcade
desc: Make your own flashcard deck, then study it with 13 arcade games: shoot the right answer, defend your castle, beat the boss and more!
tip: Turn on “Show cards I often miss more often” to practice the tricky ones.
notes: Yes or No now shows clearly which word you missed.
author: hugo

title: Evergreen
desc: Build a cozy village in the forest! Chop trees, gather stones and flowers, open cafés and cabins, and welcome happy visitors. Unlock the lake, meadow, mountains and an old woodland full of secrets.
controls: Build mode (R rotate, click to place)
tip: Lay Stone Path tiles so visitors can reach your shops, and press E at the water to go fishing.
notes: A brand-new cozy forest village to build. Your village saves by itself!
author: hugo

title: Tower Stack
desc: Drop each sliding block right on top of the last. Anything that hangs over gets sliced off. Line it up perfectly three times and the block grows back.
tip: A perfect drop keeps the full width. The sky turns to night as your tower climbs.
author: hugo

title: Merge 2048
desc: Slide the number tiles. Two of the same merge into one. Can you build the 2048 tile?
tip: Keep your biggest tile in one corner.
author: hugo

title: Five Cuts
desc: A knife slides under a loaf of bread. Cut five times: the bigger piece falls and the smaller piece stays. Miss the bread and it is over.
tip: Aim for the middle of what is left.
author: hugo

title: Planet Maker
desc: Pick a star, set the distance, size, air and water, then run 5 billion years. Will life appear? Then guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the stars.
tip: Keep the average temperature between 5 and 35 °C for the best chance of life.
author: hugo

title: Echoes of the Unknown
desc: Explore a 3D world that remembers what its people forgot. Fight, gather, take on quests and wake the ancient stones to travel.
tip: Wake the stones you find: they let you warp back later.
notes: The whole story is now in English.
author: hugo

title: Word League
desc: Learn hard English vocabulary by winning soccer league matches or conquering a fantasy map. 30 questions a match, scored like a real entrance test. For SSAT® prep · not affiliated with SSAT or The Enrollment Management Association.
notes: Only a parent with the PlayCraft PIN can change rewards now.
tip: Sign in and your progress follows your account. Words you keep missing come back until they become Legend cards.
author: hugo

title: Legend Arena
desc: Pick a fighting type, level up, and battle bots and bosses in the arena.
notes: Beat World 3 to unlock the Champion Arena!
tip: Each fighting type levels up on its own. Try them all!
author: hugo

title: Knockout 3D Boxing
desc: Knock out three opponents. Dodge at the last second, then counter for double damage.
tip: Dodge right before a hit for a PERFECT, then punch back for double damage.
author: hugo

title: Ashen Keep
desc: Cut down the undead in a ruined arena at dusk. Survive Wave 3 to open the gate to a village, quests and an endless road.
notes: Survive Wave 3 to open the gate: shops, quests, caves and new bosses!
tip: Rolling makes you invincible for a moment. Use it to escape crowds.
author: hugo

title: Black Hole Survival
desc: A 12-player survival run. Play online with friends or against bots — don’t get pulled into the black hole!
tip: Press “Play online” to race real players. Empty spots are filled with bots.
author: hugo

title: Event Horizon: Earth Escape
desc: 180 seconds until impact. Fly the last rescue ship and save the escape pods.
tip: Drop off 3 or more pods at once to refill your dash and fix your hull. Gold pods are big Arks!
author: hugo

title: Math Space War
desc: Defend your castle across alien planets. Solve math problems to power up your heroes, collect 758 of them, battle a friend 1v1 and climb the leaderboard.
notes: Game time you earn here is now shared with Study Arcade.
controls: Send heroes, upgrade energy, fire the laser
Solve a problem in battle for extra mana
Make a room and share the 4-digit code
tip: Signed in to PlayCraft? You start right away and your progress saves to your account. Wrong answers go to the Mistakes tab — fix them for bonus coins.
author: hugo
